verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a batch queue for Parse and Extract jobs with a 20% discount, async job submission that returns a job ID, and Svix webhooks with retries for completion handling. These are the building blocks of high-volume batch processing. Enterprise uptime SLAs of up to 99.99% add some predictability, but the pack never documents rate limits, concurrency caps or throughput figures. Missing for 10: documented rate limits or concurrency quotas, published throughput/latency figures for large batches, evidence of million-page-scale runs, independent hands-on corroboration at volume.
